findings.finding: The ordinary marker read uses os.ReadFile. Its temporary writer defers os.Remove without recorded ownership.
The journaled marker writer uses a bounded read but defers root.Remove of its temporary file without an ownership check.
The replacement journal and partial writer also remove temporary names without ownership checks. These writes share the remaining workspace recovery scope.
